## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `da0ad59a89a0c22d8f1b9dfe581ff359baa4d241`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/untrusted-text.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

- Read: card #34013 (body, triage note 6897851654, claim 6898285417, os-dev-report 6898642744); parent #33789 (body, its records 6897095949 and 6897706365, the canary record 6897369511, the landing notes); PR #34071 body, its two-file list, the net diff `origin/main...da0ad59a` (merge-base `fb79d47c`, three commits, 197 insertions, 27 deletions); the head's check-runs. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `mailbox-open.mjs` (`seatKey`, `mailboxOwner`, `mailboxBody`, `bodyFooter`), `check-half-states.mjs` (`readSignatureLine`, `directiveValues`, `seatOnDuty`, the H72 sweep), `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, `recordAuthorTrusted`), `fleet-write/ops.mjs` and `dispatch.mjs` headers.
- ⚠️ Check-runs at 2026-11-15T17:51Z: 47 runs, zero failures. Completed `success`: Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, all four Type Check jobs, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. STILL RUNNING: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Test Core (1/8)`. The rest are path-skipped. This record judges the tree and stands in for none of the four.
- The diff stays inside the claim: `record-recognisers.mjs` (mailbox region, its self-test rows, the header index line, the battery table and floor) and one line of `untrusted-text.md`.
- The dev's counts (412 cases, 7 ablations, 38 gates, the live census of 58 knocks) are the dev's readings; nothing was re-run here.
- `seatSessionRoster`, who gets on a seat's list. It reads three texts: the first-line signature of an open, `pm:seat`-labelled, 🟢-titled issue; the first session on each line-initial `Successor-of:` line of that body; the footer of an open `pm:mailbox`-labelled pull whose first line is `Mailbox-of: SEAT · LOGIN`. The author (`user.login`) of none of them is checked; the label is the only gate. An OUTSIDER cannot get on a roster: applying a label needs triage rights, no workflow under `.github` applies `pm:seat` or `pm:mailbox`, and an outsider cannot edit another account's body. A non-seat issue titled like a seat post lists nothing without the label (pinned), and a pull row is refused among the posts (pinned). An INSIDER can: the relay's `issue_patch` accepts any signed body "whatever it targets" (`dispatch.mjs` header), so any fleet session can rewrite a seat post or open a second labelled post or mailbox. The collision rule turns that into a refusal when the planted session sits on another seat's list, and a card-thread session sits on none. This is the trust root the card names (the post and the opening), so it is recorded as a residual, not graded against the diff; M1 below is the shorter road to the same place.
- `knockSignature` fails closed on each case the brief names, each pinned: no roster and an unreadable or malformed one; no signature line (also a signature below the key line); a signature naming no mailbox seat; a seat listing no session (vacant, paused, absent); a session the seat does not list; a session two seats list. The collision is judged after the listing, on the whole roster. No path returns `verified` without `listed.has(session)`.
- `readMailboxComment` and `mailboxEvents` keep their earlier readings: the author fence still returns before the body is parsed, `state` is `readMailboxLine`'s own, `halfStates` is computed from `state` alone, and the H72 row is pinned equal with and without a roster. Added: `signature`, `actionable`, `unverified`.
- Who consumes the new fields today: nobody. The only programmatic caller of `mailboxEvents` is the H72 sweep (`check-half-states.mjs`), which passes no roster and reads neither field. `project-forms.md` states that no gate, workflow or queue guard reads a mailbox. The act path is the rule line plus the `--mailbox-keys` printout, applied by the receiving seat by hand.
- The two never-compared pins from #34022: fixed. `t(name, ok, detail)` reads only the truthiness of `ok`; both rows passed an array there. They now pass `SAME(actual, expected)`. Static read of every `t(` row whose second argument opens with an array or object literal (about 55 rows, the multi-line one at 3334 included): each ends in `.every`, `.some` or a comparison, and no row ends with a bare expected value as a third argument. No further row of that defect found in this file. A full proof over all 412 calls is the dev's probe, not repeated.
- The PR body's sentence "an approval account runs no seat" does not hold as written: the triage note on this very card is signed `triage#1 · hotlong · …`, and `hotlong` is in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. See N1.

### ② Semver level

- `scripts/pm/**` tooling and one skill line; no published package, schema or protocol surface. No changeset owed: `skip-changeset` is on the PR and `Check Changeset` is `success`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` agree with the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, draft, base `main`, not a fork. SQL push-down: n/a.
- Dev deviation, maintainer knocks exempt from the signature check (decided in the PR, not on the card): ACCEPTED on the mechanism. The exemption keys on the platform-stamped `user.login`, the same ground the author fence and `untrusted-text.md` already stand on; a triage knock signed with the account `hotlong` arrives through the relay under the bot login and IS checked. The stated reason is wrong (N1).
- Dev deviation, the two #34022 pins repaired in place: ACCEPTED. Same file, same mailbox rows, inside the claimed surface, and the first of them had to change anyway.
- Open question ① (H72 passes no roster, so no seat is told): a follow-up card is the right carrier; `check-half-states.mjs` is outside the claim. It need not land here. But it is owed, by the lane seat, and until it lands the half of the card's Change that reads "reported to the receiving seat" is undelivered while the PR says `Fixes #34013`. Not graded against the diff. With M1 open the follow-up should wait for M1's outcome: wiring a patrol to a reading that a copied line passes would report the honest senders only.
- Open question ② (card-thread sessions under the seat's signature read unverified; 7 such knocks on one mailbox today, 9 unlisted sessions in all): NOT accepted as posed; ESCALATED to the lane seat with M1. The breakage is disclosed (the PR's Acceptance notes, the `--mailbox-keys` line for senders, the rule line for receivers), and the key table names only seats as senders, so the rule is consistent with the table. The cost is the problem: the senders this refuses are exactly those that state their own session truthfully, while a sender that copies the seat's public line is not refused (M1). The trade is worth having only once M1 is settled.
- Open question ③ (a session two seats list reads unverified, 0 today): keep. It fails closed, costs nothing today, and it is the only thing that blunts a planted listing. One consequence to know: a session planted on a second seat's post silences the genuine seat's knocks too. That is denial, never acceptance.
- Residual, for the seat's follow-up list, not graded: the roster's sources are relay-writable by any fleet session and their authors are not read (① above); a vacant seat's post lists nobody, but its mailbox, if left open, still lists its opener.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — a forged knock made by copying the seat's public signature line reads `verified` and `actionable: true`.

- The check compares the session TYPED in the knock with the session TYPED on the seat's post. Neither is proven. `fleet-write/ops.mjs` says so in its own header: "`payload.session` is still the sender's own word … it does not prove who typed it"; the seat-authored writers judge the signature's SHAPE only, and no writer compares it with the caller.
- A seat's session id is public. It is the first line of its seat post and of every comment it signs; this card's thread alone prints three.
- So the forgery the card exists for (card body: any seat session can sign as another seat) needs no new skill: copy the target seat's whole first line, session included, instead of its seat name alone. `knockSignature` then finds the session on that seat's list, on no other seat's, and returns `verified`; `readMailboxComment` returns `actionable: true`.
- What the fence does stop: a sender that names another seat but leaves its own session in the line. That is the careless forger and, today, the truthful card thread (open question ②).
- Why this is a must-fix and not a residual: before this diff no reader called any relay knock verified, and seats read every knock as a colleague's statement. After it, the tool names a copied line `verified`, the docblock calls `actionable` "the ONE field a seat acts on" and says the signature tells "who rang", and the rule line and the PR body present the check as closing the impersonation. Nothing in the diff, the PR body or the dev report discloses the copied-line case, and no self-test row pins it. This errs toward accepting a forged knock.
- What closing it takes, either way:
  - bind the knock to something the sender cannot type. The relay does know one such fact, the account that dispatched it (`execute.mjs` logs `sender` and its role per request); whether to stamp or check that is a design change outside this claim, and a decision for the seat and the maintainer (#34027 is the open decision card on whether the author fence is enough); or
  - keep the reading but stop calling it proof: a state and wording that say "listed", never who rang; `actionable` no longer described as sufficient ground to act; the copied-line case stated in the docblock, the `--mailbox-keys` line and the PR body, and pinned by a row showing a copied line reads the same as the genuine one; and the card told plainly that item 3 as written does not stop a deliberate in-fleet forger, so it does not close on this PR as if it did.

`untrusted-text.md` line 16, against the code:

- One line replaced by one line; the file is 54 lines and 3279 bytes on `main` and on this head, the line 118 bytes plus its newline on both. No growth for the line ratchet.
- `不锁` and `敲门只认中继与维护者,余者 ⛔ 不读正文` restate what #34022 landed. `签名会话非该席所列 ⇒ 不照办` is true as a one-way rule (not listed, do not act) and matches `knockSignature`. It carries M1 by omission: a reader takes "listed" for "safe". The M1 fix decides whether this line changes.
- N2 (nit): the line does not say that a maintainer's knock carries no signature and is not checked; the bullet two lines above already makes the maintainer's own hand an instruction source, so no reader is misled into refusing one.

`record-recognisers.mjs`, against the contract it implements:

- The card's acceptance rows are present: listed session read as before; any other session `unverified seat signature`; a successor session on the post verified; rows both ways; ablations reported.
- N1 (nit): the docblock and the PR body justify the maintainer exemption with "an approval account runs no seat". `hotlong` is an approver and signs `triage#1`. The exemption is sound on the other ground the same sentence gives, the platform-stamped author. Wording only.
- N3 (nit): the roster skips a row whose `state` is `closed` and treats a row with no `state` as open. A caller that passes the open listings never hands such a row; `state` equal to `open` would be the stricter spelling.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jsuo72`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `366f6946fe360f8fc4063995e3544e49c21cce1e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/untrusted-text.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

- Delta round on record 6898742069 (head `da0ad59a`, FAIL on M1, nits N1 to N3). Read: the dev's rework report 6899174847 on #34013; the delta `da0ad59a..8c4049e3` (two files, 78 insertions, 63 deletions); the merge commit `366f6946` (parents `8c4049e3` and `main` at `d3bea96d`); the net diff `origin/main...366f6946` (two files, 212 insertions, 27 deletions); the PR body and its two-file list; the head's check-runs.
- The merge: `main` brought seven commits; one of them (`828204ef`) touched `record-recognisers.mjs` outside the mailbox region. The merge commit's combined diff over both reviewed files is EMPTY, so the resolution is the automatic one and adds no hand edit. The 47 changed lines between `8c4049e3` and the head in that file are `main`'s own (the template and brief region, their self-test rows).
- Check-runs on `366f6946` at 2026-11-15T18:28Z: 48 runs, every run that was not path-skipped is completed `success`, zero failures, NONE pending. That includes `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, all four Type Check jobs, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `PR-body guards`. The PR reads `mergeable_state: clean`, draft.
- The diff stays inside the claim: the mailbox region of `record-recognisers.mjs` with its self-test rows, and one line of `untrusted-text.md`.
- The dev's counts (417 cases, ablations B1 to B5) are the dev's readings; nothing was re-run here. The CI job that runs the self-test is green on this head.
- The code path is unchanged in substance: `knockSignature` still fails closed on every case of the last round, and still returns its positive state only after `listed.has(session)` and the collision check. What changed is the names, the words, two `state` comparisons and three self-test rows.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `scripts/pm/**` tooling and one skill line; no published package, schema or protocol surface. No changeset owed; `skip-changeset` is on the PR. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` agree with the tree. The renamed fields (`listed`, `unlisted`, `consistent`) are new in this PR and have no reader on `main`, so the rename breaks nobody.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, draft, base `main`, not a fork. SQL push-down: n/a — no query, filter or data-access path in the diff.
- The PR now opens `Part of #34013`; the card is open and stays open. The undelivered half ("reported to the receiving seat", the H72 wiring) and the card-thread delegation question are named in the PR's Remainder section. ACCEPTED as the carrier. The follow-up card is still owed by the lane seat.
- The seat's ruling on M1 (no per-seat credential on this card; keep the reading, drop the claim; the new public names accepted) reached this review by relay. It is on neither the card nor the PR thread. Not a finding on the tree: the seat records it on #34013 so the card carries the reason the residual was left open.
- Open question ② of the last round (truthful card threads read `unlisted`): no longer posed by the dev; left on the card by the PR body, where the seat decides delegation. ACCEPTED as escalated. The cost is unchanged (22 of today's 58 knocks) and is stated in the 速读.
- Open question ③ (two-seat collision reads `unlisted`): kept, as accepted last round.
- Residual from the last round, still true and now written down: the roster's two sources are relay-written, any fleet session can write them, and their authors are not read. The `seatSessionRoster` docblock says so in those words.

### ④ Design judgment

M1: closed.

- The positive reading is `listed`, the negative `unlisted`, the row field `consistent`; `verified`, `unverified` (as a state) and `actionable` are gone from the diff. The only "unverified" left is the reason text `unverified seat signature`, the card's own words, and it is attached to the refusal alone, where it is true.
- The copied-line case is stated where a reader meets the reading: the `readMailboxComment` docblock (session ids are public, the relay judges shape only, a copied line reads `listed` byte-identical, "`unlisted` is the refusal; `listed` is not an approval", `consistent: true` is no ground to act on its own); the `knockSignature` docblock ("a comparison of two typed texts, never proof of who rang"); the header index line; the `--mailbox-keys` line ("Listed is consistency, not proof: a copied signature line also reads listed"); the skill line; the PR body's 速读, which gives the residual its own bullet.
- It is pinned: the new row takes the first line of the seat's post, builds a knock from it, and holds that its body equals the seat's own knock, that the two readings are the same, and that the state is `listed`. A second pin holds "not proof" in the printout.
- The card is not told the fence is done: `Part of`, and the Remainder names the per-seat credential as deliberately not bound here.
- Overclaim sweep of the net diff, the skill line and the PR body: none found. The sentence "the ONE field a seat acts on" and "who rang" as a description of the signature are gone. One refusal reason still ends "so it cannot say which seat rang"; it is on an `unlisted` reading and claims nothing for a `listed` one. The PR title states the rule, not a proof.

N1: closed. The exemption now rests on the platform-stamped `user.login` being the maintainer's own account, never the relay's shared bot login; the false sentence is gone from the docblock and the PR body. An approver account that sits a seat rings through the relay and is checked, and a row pins a relay knock signed `triage#1` with an unlisted session reading `unlisted`.

N2: closed. Line 16 carries `维护者免查`.

N3: closed. Posts and mailboxes list only when `state` reads `open`; a row with no `state` lists nobody, pinned for both.

`untrusted-text.md` line 16, against the code:

- `敲门只认中继与维护者,余不读;中继敲门须签名 listed,维护者免查;listed 非证明,可照抄。` Each clause matches the code: the author fence, the listing requirement on relay knocks, the maintainer exemption, the residual. No clause promises more than the reader does.
- One line for one line; the file is 54 lines on `main` and on this head. The line is 119 bytes (118 on `main`), the file one byte longer. No line growth for the ratchet, and the ratchet's CI job is green.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits, none with an effect on correctness or the contract:

- N4 (nit): to fit, the line gave up `信箱 PR 不锁`, which #34022 put there. The rule keeps a home in `mailbox-open.mjs` (its header and the self-test row that the open sends no lock and the relay has no lock row), and no relay row can lock a mailbox, so no seat can act against it. Accepted deviation; the PR body names it.
- N5 (nit): the line asks for a reading, `listed`, that no command prints for a given knock today; a seat applies it by hand from the `--mailbox-keys` wording until the H72 follow-up wires a roster in. Carried by the Remainder.
- N6 (nit): the approver-through-the-relay pin signs its fixture with the account `os-pm`, not an approver login. The reader never reads the signature's account, so the outcome is the same; the fixture is only less literal than the row's name.
